wiki.title: Bob Belcher
wiki.body:
Owner, head cook, and long-suffering heart of **Bob's Burgers**. A third-generation restaurateur who genuinely loves the craft of a good burger, even when nobody's buying one.

## Notes
- Author of the ever-changing pun-heavy **Burger of the Day**
- Talks to inanimate objects when stressed, which is often
- Sworn rival of Jimmy Pesto across the street
